in_sanskrit.name: गोरव
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Gorav is derived from the Sanskrit word 'goras', which means 'mountain'. The suffix 'av' denotes 'wisdom'. Thus, the name Gorav means 'mountain of wisdom'.

in_hindi.name: गोरव
in_hindi.long_meaning: In Hindi, the name Gorav is written as गोरव and pronounced as /ɡoːrəʋ/. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'goras', which means 'mountain'. The suffix 'av' denotes 'wisdom'. Thus, the name Gorav means 'mountain of wisdom' in Hindi as well.

in_tamil.name: கோரவ்
in_tamil.long_meaning: There is no direct translation of the name Gorav in Tamil. However, it can be approximated as கோரவ், which is derived from the Tamil word 'kora', which means 'mountain'. The suffix 'av' can be approximated as 'pavam', which means 'grace' or 'boon'. Thus, the name Gorav can be interpreted as 'mountain of grace' or 'mountain of boon' in Tamil.

in_telugu.name: గోరవ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: There is no direct translation of the name Gorav in Telugu. However, it can be approximated as గోరవ్, which is derived from the Telugu word 'goru', which means 'mountain'. The suffix 'av' can be approximated as 'pavam', which means 'grace' or 'boon'. Thus, the name Gorav can be interpreted as 'mountain of grace' or 'mountain of boon' in Telugu as well.

in_marathi.name: Gorav
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gorav हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is born on a mountain or has a connection with mountains. In Hindu mythology, mountains are considered sacred and are believed to be the abode of gods.
